summary: Validated 3 new features: (1) Offres du jour dashboard section fed by France Travail cron (empty-state + injected TEST_OFFER_1 works), (2) Claude adapted_title + adapted_summary on every generation, (3) Mobilité section (Permis B / Véhiculé) rendered in the exported CV. Backend pytest 29/29 pass (4 new tests added: test_generation_has_adapted_title_and_summary, test_daily_offers_endpoint, test_validate_offer_flow, test_mobility_permis_b_vehicule_in_export). Frontend Playwright: after injecting TEST_OFFER_1 in daily_offers, dashboard renders offer-card-TEST_OFFER_1 with title/entreprise/lieu/date/description + Valider button; click triggers generation, polling turns card into 'Prêt' + 4 downloads (offer-cv-pdf/docx, offer-letter-pdf/docx) within ~18s, PDF download returns 2755-byte %PDF file. France Travail API remains 'invalid_client' as expected (status.error), and the empty-state message shown when no offer is present is clear.

minor.issue: Also deletes cv sessions, but leaves stale offer_generations rows pointing to now-missing sessions -> UI can show 'Génération…' forever for a stale link. Consider cascading delete on offer_generations when cv/session is removed.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Cascade-clean offer_generations when the underlying CV/session is deleted, to avoid stuck 'Génération…' UI state.
critical_code_review_comments: offers_router.validate_offer correctly uses the user's most recent CV (sort created_at desc), analyses the offer via Claude, launches _run_generation async and upserts offer_generations — verified end-to-end via UI (Prêt + 4 downloads).
France Travail failure is handled gracefully (system_status.error is stored, empty offers returned, UI shows a helpful message) — confirmed keys are rejected upstream, not a code bug.

llm_service.generate_cv now returns adapted_title + adapted_summary; export_service.build_final_cv applies them (identity.title + summary) and renders Mobilité section for Permis B / Véhiculé in both HTML(PDF) and DOCX paths — DOCX assertions passed (word/document.xml contains 'Permis B', 'Véhiculé', 'Mobilité').
APScheduler cron 7h Europe/Paris + initial fill in server.py wired properly; refresh_daily_offers logs status even when FT rejects.
Minor: offer_generations lacks TTL and cascading delete (see minor issue above).
seed_data_creation: Injected then removed one MongoDB doc in 'daily_offers' with id=TEST_OFFER_1; offer_generations cleared after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To retest the offers Valider flow without waiting for the 7h cron, inject a doc into MongoDB daily_offers collection with the shape {id, intitule, entreprise, lieu, date_publication, description, fetched_at}. Testids: daily-offers-section, offer-card-<id>, validate-offer-<id>, offer-cv-pdf-<id>, offer-cv-docx-<id>, offer-letter-pdf-<id>, offer-letter-docx-<id>, permis-b-toggle, vehicule-toggle. France Travail API returns invalid_client (upstream — do not treat as a bug). DELETE /api/cv also removes matching sessions, so long-running offer_generations may stall; clear db.offer_generations between iterations.
